Package com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring.autoconfigure

Class SystemdProperties

java.lang.Object
com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring.autoconfigure.SystemdProperties
All Implemented Interfaces:
InitializingBean
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="systemd") public class SystemdProperties extends Object implements InitializingBean
Properties of the integration with systemd when using Spring Boot, all under systemd.
  • systemd.ready-event, when systemd is told that the application is ready;
  • systemd.status-update-period, how often the status is sent to systemd;
  • systemd.watchdog-suppress-warning, whether to log the warnings about the health signalled to the systemd watchdog;
  • systemd.status-providers.<key>.*, each built-in StatusProvider: whether it is enabled, as most of them are by default, while the others, such as the GarbageCollectionStatusProvider and the CpuStatusProvider, are opted into, to keep the status short, and the other settings of those that can be configured.

Invalid values are rejected when the properties are bound, failing the startup of the application with an InvalidConfigurationPropertyValueException that names the property.

Author:
Joao Silva, Christian Lorenz
